preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and 10000.
The number of spaceships s and bases b must be between 1 and 1000.
The cost of having a base attacked k and the cost of creating a dummy base h must be non-negative and within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 0 <= a <= 10**9 and 0 <= f <= 10**9 for x, a, f in spaceships)
preconditions.description: All spaceships must be located at valid nodes and have non-negative attack and fuel values.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 0 <= d <= 10**9 for x, d in bases)
preconditions.description: All bases must be located at valid nodes and have non-negative defensive strengths.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum cost in terms of gold.
